harrat-mujtaba:1-1.t: «سورة»: khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هذه سورة (this is a sura). The clause «أنزلناها» is a naʿt (adjective) of «سورة», and the clause «لعلكم تذكَّرون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:2-2.t: «الزانية» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); its khabar (predicate) is the clause «فاجلدوا». The fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), having entered because of the resemblance of the mubtadaʾ to a condition. «مئة» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). «رأفة» is the fāʿil (agent) of «تأخذكم». The preposition «بهما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the preposition «في دين» is likewise attached to the verb. The clause «إن كنتم» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it. The preposition «من المؤمنين» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «طائفة».

harrat-mujtaba:3-3.t: «زانٍ»: fāʿil (agent), nominative (marfūʿ) with an implied (muqaddar) ḍamma on the dropped yāʾ; it is a defective noun (ism manqūṣ). The clause «وحرِّم ذلك» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:4-4.t: «والذين»: the wāw is resumptive, and the relative noun is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «فاجلدوهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida), the relative noun being treated like a condition. «ثمانين» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); «جلدة» is a tamyīz (specification); «أبدا» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb. The clause «وأولئك هم الفاسقون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:5-5.t: «إلا الذين»: «إلا» is for exception, and the relative noun is the excepted (mustathnā). The clause «فإن الله غفور» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:6-6.t: The clause «والذين يرمون..» is conjoined to the clause {وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ} in verse (4). The wāw in «ولم يكن» is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), and the clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the pronoun in «يرمون». «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr); «أنفسهم» is a badal (substitute) of «شهداء». The fāʾ in «فشهادة» is redundant (zāʾida); «شهادة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) and «أربع» the khabar (predicate), and the clause is the khabar of «الذين». The preposition «بالله» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «شهادات». The clause «إنه لمن الصادقين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar «شهادات»; «إنَّ» takes kasra because the khabar is joined to the lām.

harrat-mujtaba:7-7.t: «والخامسة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «والخامسة أن لعنة الله عليه» is conjoined to the clause «فشهادة أحدهم أربع», in the position of the nominative. The interpreted maṣdar «أن لعنة الله عليه» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ «والخامسة». The clause «إن كان من الكاذبين» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:8-8.t: The clause «ويدرأ» is conjoined to the clause «والخامسة أن لعنة الله عليه». The interpreted maṣdar «أن تشهد» is the fāʿil (agent) of «يدرأ». «أربع» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The clause «إنه لمن الكاذبين» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar «شهادات», and the lām in «لمن» is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa).

harrat-mujtaba:9-9.t: «والخامسة» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to {أَرْبَعَ}, and the interpreted maṣdar «أن غضب الله عليها» is a badal (substitute) of «الخامسة». The clause «إن كان» is resumptive, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:10-10.t: «ولولا»: the wāw is resumptive, and [«لولا» is] a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd). «فَضْل» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being موجود (exists). The preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فضل». The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being لهلَكْتم (you would have perished). The interpreted maṣdar «وأنَّ الله تواب» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the maṣdar «فَضْل».

harrat-mujtaba:11-11.t: The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عصبة». The clause «لا تحسبوه» is resumptive; the preposition «لكم» is attached to «شرا». The clause «بل هو خير» is resumptive. The preposition «لكل» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «ما»; the preposition «منهم» is attached to a naʿt of «امرئ»; the preposition «من الإثم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما». The clause «لكل امرئ ما اكتسب» is resumptive, and the clause «والذي تولَّى..» is conjoined to the clause «لكل امرئ ما اكتسب». The clause «له عذاب» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «الذي».

harrat-mujtaba:12-12.t: «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ); «إذ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «ظن», and the clause «سمعتموه» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct): it is a past verb, the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the wāw is for prolongation (ishbāʿ), and the hāʾ is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «بأنفسهم» is attached to the second object, and «خيرا» is the first object.

harrat-mujtaba:13-13.t: «لولا» is a particle of urging (taḥḍīḍ), and the clause with it is resumptive. As for «فإذ»: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إذ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) likened to the conditional «إن», attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted verb whose implied form is كذبوا (they lied), explained by the apodosis; and the fāʾ occurs in the apodosis of the condition implied in «إذ». The clause «فإذ لم يأتوا» is conjoined to the resumptive clause, and the clause «فأولئك عند الله هم الكاذبون» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) of the condition implied in «إذ».

harrat-mujtaba:14-14.t: «ولولا فضل»: the wāw is resumptive, and [«لولا» is] a particle of non-occurrence due to occurrence (imtināʿ li-wujūd); [«فضل» is] a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, its implied form being موجود (exists). The preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فضل»; the preposition «في الدنيا» is attached to a ḥāl of «رحمته». «عذاب» is the fāʿil (agent) of «مسَّكم».

harrat-mujtaba:15-15.t: «إذ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «مسَّكم», and the clause «تلقَّونه» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The preposition «بأفواهكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «ما», and the relative noun is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The preposition «لكم» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of laysa; the preposition «به» is attached to a ḥāl of «علم». The clause «وهو عند الله عظيم» is a ḥāl of the object of «تحسبونه»; the adverb «عند» is attached to the khabar «عظيم».

harrat-mujtaba:16-16.t: «ولولا»: the wāw is resumptive; «لولا» is for urging (taḥḍīḍiyya); «إذ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «قلتم». The clause «ما يكون» is the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying); the clause «قلتم» is resumptive; the clause «سمعتموه» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The maṣdar «أن نتكلم» is the noun of «يكون»; the preposition «لنا» is attached to the khabar (predicate) of «يكون»; the preposition «بهذا» is attached to the verb «نتكلم». The clause «نسبِّح سبحانك» is resumptive within the scope of the saying, and «سبحانك» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a quasi-maṣdar (ism maṣdar). The clause «هذا بهتان عظيم» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:17-17.t: The clause «يعظكم» is resumptive. The maṣdar «أن تعودوا» is a mafʿūl li-ajlihi (object of purpose), i.e. خشية أن تعودوا (for fear that you return). The preposition and its genitive noun and the adverb are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb «تعودوا». The clause «إن كنتم مؤمنين» is parenthetical (muʿtariḍa) between the two conjoined elements, and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it.

harrat-mujtaba:18-18.t: The clause «ويبيِّن» is conjoined to the clause {يَعِظُكُمُ}; the clause «والله عليم حكيم» is resumptive, and «حكيم» is a second khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:19-19.t: The maṣdar «أن تشيع» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the preposition «في الذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تشيع». The clause «لهم عذاب» is the khabar (predicate) of «إن»; the preposition «في الدنيا» is attached to a second naʿt (adjective) of «عذاب». The clause «والله يعلم» is resumptive, and the clause «وأنتم لا تعلمون» is conjoined to the clause «والله يعلم».

harrat-mujtaba:20-20.t: The preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar (فضل). The khabar (predicate) of «فضل» is omitted, its implied form being موجود (exists). The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, its implied form being لهلكتم (you would have perished). The interpreted maṣdar «وأن الله ...» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «فَضْل».

harrat-mujtaba:21-21.t: The clause «لا تتبعوا» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «مَن» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يتبع» is its khabar (predicate). The clause «ولولا فضل الله» is resumptive, and the clause «ما زكا منكم» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أحد»; «أحد» is the fāʿil (agent), and «من» is redundant (zāʾida). «أبدا» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to «زكا». The clause «ولكن الله يزكي» is conjoined to the clause «ولولا فضل».

harrat-mujtaba:22-22.t: The clause «ولا يأتل» is resumptive; the verb is jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the weak letter. «أولو» is the fāʿil (agent), nominative with wāw, because it is treated like the sound masculine plural. The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «أولو». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يؤتوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) (في). The clause «وليعفوا» is conjoined to the clause «لا يأتل», and the clause «ألا تحبون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:23-23.t: The clause «ولهم عذاب» is conjoined to the clause «لعنوا».

harrat-mujtaba:24-24.t: «يوم»: an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the preceding khabar (predicate) is attached. The preposition «بما» is attached to «تشهد», and the clause «تشهد» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).

harrat-mujtaba:25-25.t: «يومئذ» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يوفِّيهم»; «إذٍ» is an adverbial noun, muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), indeclinable (mabnī) on sukūn, and the tanwīn compensates for a clause. The clause «يوفيهم» is resumptive. The interpreted maṣdar fills the place of the two objects. «هو» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl) with no grammatical position, and «المبين» is a naʿt (adjective) of «الحق».

harrat-mujtaba:26-26.t: The preposition «مما» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate); the clause «لهم مغفرة» is a second khabar of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «أولئك».

harrat-mujtaba:27-27.t: «غير» is a naʿt (adjective). The interpreted maṣdar «أن تستأنسوا» is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تدخلوا». The clause «ذلكم خير» is resumptive; the preposition «لكم» is attached to «خير». The clause «لعلكم تذكَّرون» is resumptive, and the clause «تَذَكَّرون» is the khabar (predicate) of laʿalla.

harrat-mujtaba:28-28.t: The clause «فإن لم تجدوا» is conjoined to the clause {لا تَدْخُلُوا}; the preposition «فيها» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «تجدوا». The clause «وإن قيل لكم» is conjoined to the clause «إن لم تجدوا»; the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) is the pronoun of the maṣdar of «قيل». The clause «هو أزكى لكم» is resumptive; the preposition «لكم» is attached to «أزكى».

harrat-mujtaba:29-29.t: The preposition «عليكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate) of laysa. The maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) (في). «غير» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بيوتا»; the clause «فيها متاع» is a second naʿt; the preposition «لكم» is attached to a naʿt of «متاع». The clause «والله يعلم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:30-30.t: «يغضُّوا»: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm), occurring in the apodosis of an implied condition, as though, when told, they would comply; and the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. غضُّوا من أبصاركم (lower your gazes). The clause «ذلك أزكى» is resumptive. «ما» in «بما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:31-31.t: The clause «وقل» is conjoined to the preceding clause {قُلْ}, and the maqūl al-qawl (object of saying) is implied, i.e. غضُّوا من أبصاركم (lower your gazes). [Translator's note: so in the source, with the masculine form.] The clause «يغضضن» is the apodosis of an implied condition. «إلا» is for exception; «ما» is a relative noun, the excepted (mustathnā). The two preposition and its genitive nouns «بخمرهن» and «على جيوبهن» are attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb, and the preposition «لبعولتهن» is attached to «يبدين». «أو ما»: a relative noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «نسائهن». «أو التابعين»: conjoined to «ما», genitive with yāʾ; «غير» is a naʿt (adjective), genitive; the preposition «من الرجال» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «التابعين»; «الذين» is a naʿt. The genitive maṣdar «ليُعلم» is attached to «يضربن»; «ما» is a relative noun, the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the preposition «من زينتهن» is attached to a ḥāl of «ما». «جميعا» is a ḥāl of the wāw. The clause «أيها المؤمنون» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «لعلكم تفلحون».

harrat-mujtaba:32-32.t: The preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الأيامى»; the preposition «من عبادكم» is attached to «الصالحين». The clause «إن يكونوا» is resumptive, and the clause «والله واسع» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:33-33.t: The clause «وليستعفف» is conjoined to the clause {وَأَنْكِحُوا}; the lām is for the command, and the imperfect verb is jussive (majzūm). The clause «والذين يبتغون..» is resumptive. The preposition «مما», composed of «مِنْ» and «ما», is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يبتغون». The clause «فكاتبوهم» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين», and the fāʾ is redundant (zāʾida) because of the relative noun's resemblance to a condition. The clause «إن علمتم فيهم خيرا» is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya). The clause «وآتوهم» is conjoined to the clause «كاتبوهم»; «الذي» is a naʿt (adjective) of «المال». The clause «ولا تكرهوا» is resumptive, and the clause «إن أردن» is parenthetical. The genitive interpreted maṣdar «لتبتغوا» is attached to «تُكرِهوا». The conditional clause «ومن يكرهن» is conjoined to the clause «لا تكرهوا»; the clause «يكرهن» is the khabar of the conditional «مَنْ»; and the preposition «من بعد» is attached to «غفور».

harrat-mujtaba:34-34.t: «مثلا»: conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «آيات». The preposition «من الذين» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «مثلا», and the preposition «للمتقين» is attached to a naʿt of «موعظة».

harrat-mujtaba:35-35.t: «مثل نوره» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «كمشكاة» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate). The clause «مثل نوره كمشكاة» is resumptive. The clause «فيها مصباح» is a naʿt (adjective) of «مشكاة»; the clause «المصباح في زجاجة» is a naʿt of «مصباح»; the clause «الزجاجة كأنها» is a naʿt of «زجاجة»; the clause «كأنها كوكب» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause «يوقد» is a second khabar; the clause «يكاد زيتها» is a naʿt of «شجرة». «زيتونة» is a badal (substitute); «لا» is negating; «شرقية» is a naʿt. As for «ولو لم تمسسه نار»: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), conjoining to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial) for exhaustiveness, i.e. it gives light in every state, even in this state. «نور» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. هو نور (it is light); the preposition «على نور» is attached to a naʿt of «نور», and the clause is resumptive, as is the clause «يهدي». The clause «يضرب الله الأمثال» is conjoined to the clause «يهدي», and the preposition «بكل» is attached to the khabar «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:36-36.t: The preposition «في بيوت» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the following verb «يسبِّح». The clause «أذن الله» is a naʿt (adjective) of «بيوت». The maṣdar «أن ترفع» is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ) (في). The clause «يسبِّح» is resumptive, and the two preposition and its genitive nouns «فيها» and «بالغدو» are attached to the verb.

harrat-mujtaba:37-37.t: «رجال»: the fāʿil (agent) of the preceding {يُسَبِّحُ}. The clause «لا تلهيهم» is a naʿt (adjective) of «رجال»; the preposition «عن ذكر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the verb; the clause «يخافون» is a second naʿt. «يوما» cannot be an adverb (ẓarf), because the fear that benefits them does not take place on that day. The clause «تتقلَّب» is a naʿt of «يوما».

harrat-mujtaba:38-38.t: The genitive maṣdar «ليجزيهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) {يَخَافُونَ}. «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). «أحسن» is the second object. The clause «والله يرزق» is resumptive; the preposition «بغير» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يرزق».

harrat-mujtaba:39-39.t: The clause «والذين كفروا ...» is resumptive, and the clause «أعمالهم كسراب» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «الذين»; the preposition «كسراب» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar of the mubtadaʾ «أعمالهم». The preposition «بقيعة» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «سراب»; the clause «يحسبه» is a second naʿt of «سراب». «حتى» is inceptive (ibtidāʾiyya), and the conditional clause is resumptive. The adverb «عنده» is attached to the verb «وجد». The clause «والله سريع» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:40-40.t: The preposition «كظلمات» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preposition {كَسَرَابٍ} and attached to what that is attached to. The preposition «في بحر» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «ظلمات». The clause «يغشاه موج» is a naʿt of «بحر»; the clause «من فوقه موج» is a naʿt of the first «موج»; the clause «من فوقه سحاب» is a naʿt of the second «موج». «ظلمات» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هي ظلمات (they are darknesses). The clause «بعضها فوق بعض» is a naʿt of «ظلمات», and the conditional clause is a second naʿt of «ظلمات», the linking pronoun being implied, i.e. فيها. The clause «ومن لم يجعل» is resumptive; the clause «لم يجعل» is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause «فما له من نور» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ). «من نور» is a mubtadaʾ, and «من» is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:41-41.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله ...» fills the place of the two objects of «تر». «والطير» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «مَنْ»; «صافَّات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الطير». The clause «كل قد علم» is a ḥāl of the relative noun and what is conjoined to it. As for «بما»: the bāʾ is a preposition, «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is genitive, attached to (mutaʿalliq) «عليم».

harrat-mujtaba:42-42.t: The clause «ولله ملك» is conjoined to the clause «الله عليم», and the clause «إلى الله المصير» is conjoined to the clause «لله ملك».

harrat-mujtaba:43-43.t: The interpreted maṣdar «أن الله ...» fills the place of the two objects of «تر». The clause «يخرج» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «الودق». The preposition «من السماء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «يُنزل»; the preposition «من جبال» is attached to «ينزل» and is a badal (substitute) of the preceding preposition and its genitive noun, a badal of inclusion (badal ishtimāl), and «مِن» is for the beginning of the extent. The preposition «فيها» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «جبال». «من بَرَد» is attached to «ينزل», and «مِن» is partitive; it is permissible for two particles of the same form to be attached to a single governor because their meanings differ. The clause «يكاد» is a ḥāl of «الودق».

harrat-mujtaba:44-44.t: The clause «يقِّلب» is resumptive; the lām in «لعبرة» is for emphasis; and the preposition «لأولي» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «عبرة».

harrat-mujtaba:45-45.t: The clause «والله خلق» is conjoined to the clause {يُقَلِّبُ}, and the clause «فمنهم من يمشي» is conjoined to the clause «الله خلق». «مَن» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate).

harrat-mujtaba:46-46.t: The clause «لقد أنزلنا» occurs as the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and the clause «والله يهدي» is conjoined to the clause «لقد أنزلنا».

harrat-mujtaba:47-47.t: The clause «ويقولون» is resumptive. The preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فريق»; the preposition «من بعد» is attached to «يتولَّى». The clause «وما أولئك بالمؤمنين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «فريق»; the ḥāl from an indefinite is permissible because it is described by «منهم». «ما» operates like laysa, [followed by] its noun and its khabar (predicate), and the bāʾ is redundant (zāʾida).

harrat-mujtaba:48-48.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {وَيَقُولُونَ}. The second «إذا» is the «إذا» of surprise (fujāʾiyya). «فريق» is a mubtadaʾ (subject); the preposition «منهم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a naʿt (adjective) of «فريق»; «معرضون» is the khabar (predicate) of «فريق». The conditional «إذا» is attached to the sense of the apodosis.

harrat-mujtaba:49-49.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the preceding conditional clause, and «مذعنين» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw.

harrat-mujtaba:50-50.t: «مرض» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). «أم» is the disjunctive (munqaṭiʿa) one, and the clause after it is a mubtadaʾ [Translator's note: so in the source; probably "resumptive" (mustaʾnafa) is meant]; likewise the second «أم» is disjunctive. The interpreted maṣdar «أن يحيف» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «أولئك هم الظالمون» is resumptive, and «هم» is for separation (faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:51-51.t: «إنما»: a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa), having no governing effect. «إذا» is purely adverbial (ẓarfiyya maḥḍa), and the clause «دُعُوا» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The genitive maṣdar «ليحكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «دُعُوا». The interpreted maṣdar «أن يقولوا» is the noun of kāna. The wāw in «وأولئك» is parenthetical (iʿtirāḍiyya), and «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl); the clause «وأولئك هم المفلحون» is parenthetical.

harrat-mujtaba:52-52.t: The conditional clause is conjoined to the clause {إِنَّمَا كَانَ قَوْلَ}. «مَنْ» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يطع» is its khabar (predicate). «ويتقه» is jussive (majzūm) by dropping of the weak letter, because it ends in a weak letter; its original form is «ويتقِه», then it was given sukūn for lightness because of the many vowels. They treated a separable [sequence] such as «ويتقه» like a single word such as «كَبِد»: they give sukūn to the ʿayn of faʿil and say «كَبْد», because it is a single word, and then they treated what resembles it among separable sequences in the same way as a single word. For in «يتقِه» there came to be «تَقِهِ», equivalent to «كَتِف», so it was given sukūn as that is given sukūn. «هم» is a pronoun of separation (ḍamīr faṣl).

harrat-mujtaba:53-53.t: «جهد» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. أقسموا إقسام اجتهاد (they swore with a strenuous swearing). The clause «لئن أمرتهم ليخرجن» is explicative (tafsīriyya) of the content of the oath; the lām in «لئن» paves the way for the oath (muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam). «يخرجن» is an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ) by the presence of the nūn, which was dropped because of the succession of identical letters; the wāw, dropped because of the meeting of two quiescent letters, is the fāʿil (agent), and the nūn is for emphasis. The apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the answer to the oath. «طاعة» is a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is omitted, i.e. طاعة معروفة أمثل بكم (a known obedience is more fitting for you). The clause «طاعة معروفة أمثل» is resumptive within the scope of the saying.

harrat-mujtaba:54-54.t: «ما» is a relative noun, a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause «فإن تولَّوا» is resumptive, and the clause «وما على الرسول إلا البلاغ» is resumptive: the wāw is resumptive, «ما» is negating and inoperative (muhmala), «البلاغ» is a mubtadaʾ, the preposition «على الرسول» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and «إلا» is restrictive (li-l-ḥaṣr).

harrat-mujtaba:55-55.t: The second object of the promise is omitted, i.e. الاستخلاف (the granting of succession). The clause «ليستخلفنَّهم» is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam). The kāf in «كما» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), i.e. استخلافا مثل استخلاف الذين (a succession like the succession of those…). «أمْنًا» is the second object. The clause «يعبدونني» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the object of «يبدِّلنهم», and the clause «لا يشركون» is a ḥāl of the fāʿil (agent) of «يعبدون». The clause «ومن كفر» is conjoined to the clause «وعد الله», and the clause «كفر» is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ (subject) «من».

harrat-mujtaba:56-56.t: The clause «وأقيموا» is conjoined to the clause {أَطِيعُوا} in verse (54); the clause «لعلكم ترحمون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:57-57.t: «لا» is prohibitive; [then] an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on fatḥa, in the position of the jussive. «معجزين» is the second object; the preposition «في الأرض» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) «معجزين». The clause «ومأواهم النار» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «لا تحسبن»; conjoining a declarative to an injunctive is permissible. As for «ولبئس المصير»: the wāw is resumptive, and the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; [then] a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); the specified [noun] (makhṣūṣ) is omitted, i.e. جهنم (Hell). The clause «ولبئس المصير» is the answer to the oath (jawāb al-qasam), and the clause «ووالله لبئس المصير» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:58-58.t: «الذين» is an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) of the one addressed (munādā). The clause «ليستأذنكم» is the response to the vocative, resumptive. «والذين» is a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to the preceding relative noun; the preposition «منكم» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw. «ثلاث» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object). The preposition «من قبل» is attached to «يستأذن»; «حين» is an adverb of time (ẓarf zamān) attached to «يستأذن»; and the preposition «من بعد» is attached to «يستأذن». «ثلاث» is the khabar (predicate) of an omitted mubtadaʾ (subject), i.e. هي ثلاث, and the clause is resumptive. The preposition «لكم» is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «عورات». The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» is a naʿt of «ثلاث». «بعدهن» is an adverb attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. «طوَّافون» is the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. هم, and the clause is resumptive; the preposition «عليكم» is attached to «طوافون». «بعضكم» is a mubtadaʾ, and the preposition «على بعض» is attached to the khabar; the clause «بعضكم على بعض» is a badal (substitute) of the clause «هم طوافون». The kāf in «كذلك» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, the implied sense being: يبين الله تبيينا مثل ذلك التبيين (Allah makes clear with a clarifying like that clarifying). The clause «يبين» is resumptive, and likewise the clause «والله عليم حكيم».

harrat-mujtaba:59-59.t: The conditional clause is resumptive, and the clause «بلغ» is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The fāʾ is linking (rābiṭa), and the lām is for the command. The kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), the implied sense being: استئذانا مثل استئذان (asking leave like the asking leave of…). The kāf in «كذلك» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, i.e. يبيِّن تبيينا مثل ذلك التبيين (He makes clear with a clarifying like that clarifying). The clause «يبين» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:60-60.t: The wāw in «والقواعد» is a conjunction, and «القواعد» is a mubtadaʾ (subject). The preposition «من النساء» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) a ḥāl (circumstantial) of «النساء» [Translator's note: so in the source; presumably «القواعد» is meant]. «اللاتي» is a naʿt (adjective). The fāʾ in «فليس» is redundant (zāʾida), and the clause «فليس جناح» is the khabar (predicate). The interpreted maṣdar «أن يضعن» is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ). «غير» is a ḥāl of the nūn in «يضعن», and the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to «متبرجات». The maṣdar «وأن يستعففن» is a mubtadaʾ, and its khabar is «خير»; the clause «والاستعفاف خير» is conjoined to the clause «القواعد ليس عليهن جناح». The preposition «لهن» is attached to «خير». The clause «والله سميع عليم» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:61-61.t: The preposition «على الأعرج» is conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «على الأعمى» and attached to (mutaʿalliq) what that is attached to, and the second «حرج» is conjoined to the preceding one. As for «ولا على أنفسكم أن تأكلوا»: the wāw is a conjunction, «لا» is negating, and the preposition and its genitive noun is conjoined to «على المريض» and attached to what that is attached to; «أن» is the particle that puts the verb in the subjunctive, and the maṣdar is accusative by removal of the preposition (manṣūb bi-nazʿ al-khāfiḍ), i.e. ولا على أنفسكم حرج في أن تأكلوا (nor is there blame on yourselves in eating). «أو ما ملكتم»: a relative noun, genitive, conjoined to «خالاتكم». «أو صديقكم»: a noun conjoined to «ما», genitive. The clause «ليس عليكم جناح» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن تأكلوا» is accusative by removal of the preposition (في); «جميعا» is a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the wāw. The conditional clause is resumptive; «إذا» is an adverbial conditional particle (ẓarfiyya sharṭiyya) attached to the sense of the apodosis. «تحية» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), being synonymous with its governor; the preposition and its genitive noun is attached to a naʿt (adjective) of «تحية». The clause «يبيِّن» is resumptive, and the kāf is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq. The clause «لعلكم تعقلون» is resumptive.

harrat-mujtaba:62-62.t: «إنما» is a restraining particle and the restrained one (kāffa wa-makfūfa). The conditional clause is conjoined to the ṣila (relative clause) of «الذين». «معه» is an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) the khabar (predicate), and the preposition «على أمر» is attached to the [notion of] settledness (istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached. The clause «أولئك الذين» is the khabar of «إنَّ». The conditional clause «فإذا استأذنوك» is conjoined to the resumptive clause «إن الذين..».

harrat-mujtaba:63-63.t: «بينكم»: an adverb of place (ẓarf makān) attached to (mutaʿalliq) the maṣdar «دعاء». The preposition «كدعاء» is attached to the second object of «جعل»; «بعضا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the maṣdar «دعاء». The clause «قد يعلم الله» is resumptive; the preposition «منكم» is attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) of the fāʿil (agent) of «يتسللون». «لواذا» is a substitute for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is synonymous with its verb. The clause «فليحذر» is resumptive, and the maṣdar «أن تصيبهم» is a mafʿūl bihi of «يحذر».

harrat-mujtaba:64-64.t: «ألا» is an opening particle (ḥarf istiftāḥ), and the clause after it is resumptive. The preposition «في السماوات» is attached to (mutaʿalliq) the implied ṣila (relative clause). The clause «قد يعلم» is resumptive. «ويوم يرجعون»: a noun conjoined (maʿṭūf) to «ما», as a mafʿūl bihi (direct object). The clause «فينبئهم» is conjoined to the clause «يرجعون»; «ما» is maṣdariyya (infinitival), and the interpreted maṣdar is attached to the verb. The clause «والله بكل شيء عليم» is resumptive, and the preposition «بكل» is attached to the khabar (predicate) «عليم».
